name: t3code-thread-bridge
description: Inspect and message T3 Code threads across local and T3 Connect environments.

interface.shortDescription: Message threads across all your T3 Code devices.
interface.longDescription: Discovers this device and every environment linked through T3 Connect. It can find and inspect threads across computers, then route follow-up messages securely to the device that owns each thread.
defaultPrompt: List my T3 Code environments and recent threads.
Read a T3 Code thread I identify.
Send a queued follow-up to a T3 Code thread.
